newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: De Boer aims to maintain dividend policy.
newsitem.headline: De Boer aims to maintain dividend policy.

text.p: Supermarkets group De Boer Winkelbedrijven NV and wholesaler Unigro said on Tuesday their newly combined group would aim to maintain the De Boer policy of paying a dividend of around 35 percent of post tax earnings.
"It is the intention of the combined group to continue the De Boer policy of paying around 35 percent of ordinary earnings after tax as a dividend," the group said in a statement.

The combine, which signed a final merger agreement on May 2, gave a briefing on Tuesday outlining a profit forecast and long term strategy. The company is planning to publish half year figures in late August.
De Boer Unigro said the dividend would be available either as shares or in cash.
